Furthermore, due to a regulatory agreement, exactly one of the following two transit corridors must be incorporated into the circuit: the corridor between Hub Beta and Hub Gamma, or the corridor between Hub Gamma and Hub Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient cyclical route that visits every hub precisely once and concludes at the point of origin.
